Callout.Name: Suspected Sepsis
Callout.Message: Person unwell with a high temperature and confusion.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, hot to touch, family reporting a recent infection.

Script.Line: It started as a chest thing last week.
I have been shaking since the morning and I cannot keep anything down.
Is it the infection? Tell me straight, is it the infection?

Callout.Patient: I am so cold. Why am I so cold?

Lines.Approach: Hot, confused, and there was an infection last week. That set of things together is not ordinary.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
